changeSet.author: Codex
changeSet.comment: Create the board-owned catalog of inspected, committed raster files. Deduplicate hashes within each board, retain files for draft/history use until board deletion, and keep staged uploads out of this catalog.

createTable.remarks: Immutable committed raster files owned and accounted for by one whiteboard

column.name: page_id
column.remarks: Owning whiteboard; the same hash on another board is a separate asset

column.name: content_hash
column.remarks: SHA-256 of the original file bytes as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters

column.name: storage_key
column.remarks: Unique physical object generation; never reused by a later upload

column.name: file_size
column.remarks: Inspected original byte count, charged once per board-owned hash

column.name: mime_type
column.remarks: Image MIME type verified by decoding the uploaded bytes

column.name: width
column.remarks: Inspected intrinsic pixel width

column.name: height
column.remarks: Inspected intrinsic pixel height

column.name: created_by
column.remarks: Externally owned actor identity; no local user-cache foreign key

column.name: provenance
column.remarks: Bounded server-owned metadata describing the asset source

column.name: inspector_version
column.remarks: Image validation version used before catalog commitment

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE whiteboard.whiteboard_asset ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_asset_hash_ck CHECK (content_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'), ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_asset_storage_key_ck CHECK (storage_key LIKE 'whiteboard-v2-assets/%' AND length(storage_key) <= 512), ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_asset_size_ck CHECK (file_size > 0 AND file_size <= 20971520), ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_asset_mime_ck CHECK (mime_type IN ('image/png','image/jpeg','image/webp')), ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_asset_width_ck CHECK (width BETWEEN 1 AND 16384), ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_asset_height_ck CHECK (height BETWEEN 1 AND 16384), ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_asset_provenance_ck CHECK (jsonb_typeof(provenance)='object' AND octet_length(provenance::text) <= 4096), ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_asset_inspector_ck CHECK (inspector_version > 0), ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_asset_pixels_ck CHECK (width::bigint * height <= 64000000);

changeSet.author: Codex
changeSet.comment: Persist actor-scoped upload sessions and retry receipts independently of canvas checkpoints. Preserve expected file identity, quota reservations, and storage-attempt leases so retries, cancellation, and crash recovery cannot publish unfinished files or charge the same upload twice.

createTable.remarks: Upload lifecycle and terminal retry receipts retained while the owning board exists

column.name: actor_id
column.remarks: Authenticated upload owner; the session ID alone does not grant access

column.name: idempotency_key
column.remarks: Prepare retry key scoped to this board and actor

column.name: request_hash
column.remarks: Digest of normalized prepare metadata; detects conflicting key reuse

column.name: expected_hash
column.remarks: Expected SHA-256 of the exact original bytes

column.name: state
column.remarks: prepared, staging, staged, committed, cancelled, or expired

column.name: storage_key
column.remarks: Current attempt's unique object key, persisted before storage I/O

column.name: width
column.remarks: Verified pixel width; required once staging succeeds

column.name: height
column.remarks: Verified pixel height; required once staging succeeds

column.name: reservation
column.remarks: Durable quota reservation; cleared atomically on commitment or termination

column.name: lease_id
column.remarks: Attempt fence; prevents a late writer from finalizing a replacement attempt

column.name: lease_until
column.remarks: Storage-attempt deadline used to recover abandoned writes

column.name: expires_at
column.remarks: Upload eligibility deadline; expiry does not permit idempotency-key reuse

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE whiteboard.whiteboard_asset_upload ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_asset_upload_request_hash_ck CHECK (request_hash ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'), ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_asset_upload_expected_hash_ck CHECK (expected_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'), ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_asset_upload_type_ck CHECK (content_type IN ('image/png','image/jpeg','image/webp')), ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_asset_upload_size_ck CHECK (byte_length > 0 AND byte_length <= 20971520), ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_asset_upload_state_ck CHECK (state IN ('prepared','staging','staged','committed','cancelled','expired')), ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_asset_upload_storage_key_ck CHECK (storage_key LIKE 'whiteboard-v2-assets/%' AND length(storage_key) <= 512), ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_asset_upload_width_ck CHECK (width BETWEEN 1 AND 16384), ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_asset_upload_height_ck CHECK (height BETWEEN 1 AND 16384), ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_asset_upload_inspector_ck CHECK (inspector_version > 0), ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_asset_upload_reservation_ck CHECK (jsonb_typeof(reservation)='object' AND octet_length(reservation::text) <= 8192), ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_asset_upload_pixels_ck CHECK (width IS NULL OR height IS NULL OR width::bigint * height <= 64000000), ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_asset_upload_ready_ck CHECK (state NOT IN ('staged','committed') OR (width IS NOT NULL AND height IS NOT NULL AND inspector_version IS NOT NULL AND storage_key IS NOT NULL)), ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_asset_upload_staging_ck CHECK (state <> 'staging' OR (lease_id IS NOT NULL AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND storage_key IS NOT NULL)), ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_asset_upload_lease_ck CHECK ((lease_id IS NULL) = (lease_until IS NULL)), ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_asset_upload_expiry_ck CHECK (expires_at > created_at);

changeSet.author: Codex
changeSet.comment: Index only active upload sessions for expiry recovery. Keep retained terminal retry receipts out of the worker's expiry scan.

changeSet.author: Codex
changeSet.comment: Record the exact committed raster dependencies of each immutable snapshot and bind completed inspection to its state digest. A manifest with no associations proves the snapshot was inspected and has no raster dependencies; same-board foreign keys protect published reads and restore.

createTable.remarks: Completed asset inspection bound to an immutable snapshot digest and extractor version

column.name: state_digest
column.remarks: SHA-256 digest of the exact inspected snapshot bytes

column.name: extractor_version
column.remarks: Server asset-extraction contract used to validate membership

createTable.remarks: Exact raster membership used to authorize version-scoped downloads and preserve restore dependencies

column.name: page_id
column.remarks: Shared ownership key for both the snapshot and committed asset

changeSet.author: Codex
changeSet.comment: Persist retryable object-deletion jobs before owner rows disappear. Preserve the object key and former ownership without cascading foreign keys so cancellation, expired uploads, and board deletion remain recoverable. Physical deletion does not release quota again; the lifecycle transaction does.

createTable.remarks: Durable object cleanup with bounded retries and leases; survives board and space deletion

column.name: page_id
column.remarks: Former owner, deliberately retained without a foreign key

column.name: space_id
column.remarks: Former space identity retained for recovery and diagnostics

column.name: account_id
column.remarks: Former billing account, when available; physical cleanup does not change quota

column.name: storage_key
column.remarks: Exact object generation to delete; unique across all cleanup jobs

column.name: byte_count
column.remarks: Object bytes for cleanup diagnostics, not a second quota release

column.name: not_before
column.remarks: Earliest deletion attempt after write grace or retry backoff

column.name: lease_id
column.remarks: Worker claim fence; stale completion cannot overwrite a newer claim

column.name: last_error
column.remarks: Bounded diagnostic text from the most recent failed deletion

column.name: exhausted_at
column.remarks: Retry budget exhausted; retained for operator investigation

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE whiteboard.whiteboard_asset_cleanup ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_asset_cleanup_page_ck CHECK (page_id > 0), ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_asset_cleanup_storage_key_ck CHECK (storage_key LIKE 'whiteboard-v2-assets/%' AND length(storage_key) <= 512), ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_asset_cleanup_bytes_ck CHECK (byte_count >= 0), ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_asset_cleanup_reason_ck CHECK (length(reason) BETWEEN 1 AND 128), ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_asset_cleanup_attempts_ck CHECK (attempt_count >= 0), ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_asset_cleanup_lease_ck CHECK ((lease_id IS NULL) = (lease_until IS NULL)), ADD CONSTRAINT whiteboard_asset_cleanup_terminal_ck CHECK (completed_at IS NULL OR exhausted_at IS NULL);

changeSet.author: Codex
changeSet.comment: Index pending object-deletion jobs by their next eligible attempt. Retain completed and exhausted jobs for diagnostics without including them in the cleanup worker's pending-work index.

append.value: WHERE completed_at IS NULL AND exhausted_at IS NULL

changeSet.author: Codex
changeSet.comment: Enforce immutable upload identity, legal lifecycle transitions, and immutable committed catalog content in PostgreSQL. Terminal sessions cannot be revived, and a file replacement must create a new asset hash.

changeSet.author: Codex
changeSet.comment: Grant the application role access to the five v2 asset tables so HTTP handlers, publication/restore, and cleanup workers can use them. Grants are explicit because core-schema defaults do not cover whiteboard tables.
changeSet.sql: GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON whiteboard.whiteboard_asset, whiteboard.whiteboard_asset_upload, whiteboard.whiteboard_snapshot_asset, whiteboard.whiteboard_snapshot_asset_manifest, whiteboard.whiteboard_asset_cleanup TO ${app_user};

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON whiteboard.whiteboard_asset, whiteboard.whiteboard_asset_upload, whiteboard.whiteboard_snapshot_asset, whiteboard.whiteboard_snapshot_asset_manifest, whiteboard.whiteboard_asset_cleanup FROM ${app_user};
